decisions.reason: It extends the core dumper range and its continued standalone promotion in 2023 and 2024 suggests normal market acceptance and strategic fit.
As an articulated construction dumper close to the established business and still actively marketed on its own page, it is likely to remain in the portfolio.
This mine rescue vehicle is farther from the core range and its reduced visibility from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024 points to weak commercialization or a niche one-off role.
A multi-model telescopic loader line squarely fits the firm's capabilities and its persistent standalone presentation indicates commitment and likely ongoing sales potential.
Although only mentioned on the website, the reported large order and long-standing popularity of the material lift concept argue for continuation rather than withdrawal.
Despite being more distant from the established offer, the strong quantified early operating result and dedicated 2024 product page make continuation the more likely management choice.
